title: Social conversations
scenario: During a break, you greet a colleague and chat about how things have been.

lines.text: What a lovely afternoon! How have you been lately?
Very well, thank you. I have been quite busy with school.
I understand. I work now on a new project.
What kind of project? It sounds interesting.
I am developing new English activities for the students.
A social event for teachers would be a great idea.
I agree completely. Let's discuss the details over coffee.
I always plan ahead when I know about events early.

ai_conversation.scenario: Engage in friendly social conversation with colleagues after work.
ai_conversation.opening_line: Hello! Did you have a chance to relax over the weekend?
ai_conversation.success_criteria: Learner makes friendly small talk and discusses personal hobbies.
